working_title: Session-Local Latent Memory Banks for Long-Context Reasoning in MemGen
final_scoped_claim: We add a session-local latent memory bank to MemGen and show that it improves long-context event reasoning without retraining the Trigger, Weaver, or Reasoner.
operational_scope: Frozen P7 on EventQA-65536 under the local MemoryAgentBench frozen-bank contract.
claims_not_made: superiority over summaries RAG or matched-budget text before completion
cost efficiency from combined paired cost records
why_locomo_is_not_positive: P7 has zero exact match on all 304 paired questions despite active retrieval; the open-ended latent-only query contract requires exact conversational fact decoding unlike EventQA closed-set event selection.
locomo_paper_placement: Limitations and appendix only; do not claim multi-turn improvement.
next_action: Run a method-separable EventQA cost smoke on context 0 questions 0-9 for Disabled and frozen P7 after logging and schema preparation.
